excludePrivate+liveOnly.sql: SELECT DISTINCT tag FROM tags WHERE page_id IN (SELECT id FROM pages WHERE slug = $1 AND source_id = $2 AND (COALESCE(pages.frontmatter->>'visibility', CASE WHEN (pages.type = 'atom' OR (pages.type = 'concept' AND pages.frontmatter->>'synthesized_by' IS NOT NULL)) THEN 'private' ELSE 'world' END) <> 'private' AND NOT (CASE WHEN pages.type = 'atom' THEN EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM pages derived_origin WHERE derived_origin.source_id = pages.source_id AND derived_origin.slug = pages.frontmatter->>'source_slug' AND derived_origin.frontmatter->>'visibility' = 'private') WHEN (pages.type = 'atom' OR (pages.type = 'concept' AND pages.frontmatter->>'synthesized_by' IS NOT NULL)) THEN EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM links derived_input_link JOIN pages derived_input ON derived_input.id = derived_input_link.to_page_id WHERE derived_input_link.from_page_id = pages.id AND derived_input_link.link_source = 'concept-provenance' AND derived_input_link.link_type = 'synthesized_from' AND (COALESCE(derived_input.frontmatter->>'visibility', CASE WHEN derived_input.type = 'atom' THEN 'private' ELSE 'world' END) = 'private' OR EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM pages derived_input_origin WHERE derived_input_origin.source_id = derived_input.source_id AND derived_input_origin.slug = derived_input.frontmatter->>'source_slug' AND derived_input_origin.frontmatter->>'visibility' = 'private'))) WHEN pages.type = 'event' AND pages.frontmatter->>'captured_via' LIKE 'life-chronicle:%' THEN NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM pages chronicle_origin WHERE chronicle_origin.source_id = pages.source_id AND chronicle_origin.slug = pages.frontmatter->'event'->>'depth' AND COALESCE(chronicle_origin.frontmatter->>'visibility', CASE WHEN (chronicle_origin.type = 'atom' OR (chronicle_origin.type = 'concept' AND chronicle_origin.frontmatter->>'synthesized_by' IS NOT NULL)) THEN 'private' ELSE 'world' END) <> 'private' AND NOT (CASE WHEN jsonb_typeof(chronicle_origin.frontmatter->'derived_from') IN ('array', 'string') THEN EXISTS ( SELECT 1 FROM pages declared_origin WHERE declared_origin.source_id = chronicle_origin.source_id AND declared_origin.frontmatter->>'visibility' = 'private' AND declared_origin.slug IN ( SELECT regexp_replace(declared.slug, '\.md$', '') FROM jsonb_array_elements_text( CASE WHEN jsonb_typeof(chronicle_origin.frontmatter->'derived_from') = 'array' THEN chronicle_origin.frontmatter->'derived_from' ELSE jsonb_build_array(chronicle_origin.frontmatter->'derived_from') END) AS declared(slug))) ELSE false END)) ELSE false END) AND NOT (CASE WHEN jsonb_typeof(pages.frontmatter->'derived_from') IN ('array', 'string') THEN EXISTS ( SELECT 1 FROM pages declared_origin WHERE declared_origin.source_id = pages.source_id AND declared_origin.frontmatter->>'visibility' = 'private' AND declared_origin.slug IN ( SELECT regexp_replace(declared.slug, '\.md$', '') FROM jsonb_array_elements_text( CASE WHEN jsonb_typeof(pages.frontmatter->'derived_from') = 'array' THEN pages.frontmatter->'derived_from' ELSE jsonb_build_array(pages.frontmatter->'derived_from') END) AS declared(slug))) ELSE false END)) AND deleted_at IS NULL) ORDER BY tag
